name: url
description: Your WebSocket server. Must start with wss://. Twilio connects here when the call reaches <Connect>.
consider: Built from SERVER_URL in routes/voice.js. If the tunnel URL changes and .env isn't updated, the greeting may play but the conversation never starts.

name: welcomeGreeting
description: Text Twilio speaks the moment the session starts. Your LLM isn't involved, so the first sentence has no added latency.
consider: Set per call in routes/voice.js (it includes the nurse's name). Always add it to the LLM history, or the model will greet a second time.

name: welcomeGreetingInterruptible
description: Whether the caller can talk over (or press keys during) the welcome greeting.
consider: Use 'none' if the greeting contains a required disclosure, such as 'this call may be recorded' or 'I am an automated assistant'.

name: applicationReconnect
description: If your WebSocket drops, Twilio buffers events and reconnects instead of failing the call. Setup then carries connectionType=reconnect and reconnectAttempt.
consider: This app does NOT handle reconnects yet. A reconnect would start a fresh session with no history. Exercise: key sessions by callSid so they survive.

name: language
description: Sets both the TTS and STT language.
consider: Switch mid-call by sending a {type:'language'} message. For several languages, add <Language> child elements, or use code='multi' (requires ElevenLabs + Deepgram).

name: ttsLanguage
description: TTS language when a text token has no 'lang'. Overrides language for speech output only.
consider: Useful when you understand several languages but always reply in one.

name: transcriptionLanguage
description: STT language. Overrides language for recognition only.
consider: Set it to match your callers. A wrong language makes accurate transcripts look like gibberish.

name: ttsProvider
description: Which engine speaks your text.
consider: Changing the provider without changing voice to a voice from that provider is an invalid combination. The WebSocket never connects and you get error 64101 at the action URL.

name: voice
description: Provider voice ID. Defaults: ElevenLabs UgBBYS2sOqTuMpoF3BR0, Google en-US-Chirp3-HD-Aoede, Amazon Joanna-Neural.
consider: ElevenLabs format: VOICE_ID-MODEL-SPEED_STABILITY_SIMILARITY. Twilio recommends the v4 model (append -v4). v3 and v4 don't support speed, so omit it or use 1.0.

name: elevenlabsTextNormalization
description: Has ElevenLabs expand numbers, times, currency and abbreviations before speaking. 'auto' behaves like 'off'.
consider: Turn this on when the model outputs '7 PM' or '$15'. The alternative is telling the model to spell everything out, which costs prompt tokens and is unreliable.

name: transcriptionProvider
description: Which engine transcribes the caller. Deepgram is the default for accounts created after Sept 12, 2025.
consider: Change provider and speechModel together. Not every model exists on both.

name: speechModel
description: The STT model for the chosen provider.
consider: Deepgram Flux models add model-based end-of-turn detection (see eotThreshold). Check the docs for the current model list.

name: speechTimeout
description: Milliseconds of silence before Twilio decides the caller has finished and sends 'prompt'. With Deepgram Flux, this is the maximum silence before the turn is forced to end.
consider: Lower values feel snappier but cut off people who pause mid-sentence ('I could… maybe do Sunday'). Nurses checking a calendar pause, so don't go too low.

name: eotThreshold
description: End-of-turn confidence threshold. Only applies to Deepgram + Flux.
consider: Lower ends turns sooner (faster, more cut-offs). Higher waits for more certainty.

name: hints
description: Comma-separated words and phrases the recognizer should expect.
consider: Use for domain vocabulary: unit names (Med-Surg, Step-Down), names, product names. Here it's computed per shift unless you override it.

name: partialPrompts
description: Stream interim transcripts while the caller is still talking (prompt messages with last:false).
consider: For advanced latency tricks such as speculative LLM calls. This app ignores last:false prompts. Without that guard, every partial would trigger a model reply.

name: partialPromptOnHangup
description: If the caller hangs up mid-sentence, send what was transcribed so far.
consider: Useful for logging last words ('actually yes, I'll ta—').

name: deepgramSmartFormat
description: Deepgram formats numbers, dates and punctuation in transcripts.
consider: Keep it on for readable transcripts. Turn it off if you parse raw digits yourself.

name: profanityFilter
description: Masks profanity in transcripts (all but the first letter).
consider: Some teams turn it off so they can detect upset callers and escalate.

name: interruptible
description: Which caller input stops the agent mid-sentence (barge-in). Twilio stops audio and sends you 'interrupt'.
consider: 'any' feels most human. Use 'none' for things that must be heard in full (legal disclosures). The text message also has a per-reply 'interruptible' flag for that.

name: interruptSensitivity
description: How easily caller sound counts as an interruption.
consider: Lower it for noisy environments, such as nurses calling from a busy unit or a car.

name: ignoreBackchannel
description: Don't treat short acknowledgements ('mm-hm', 'yeah', 'okay') as interruptions.
consider: Usually worth turning on. People say 'mm-hm' while listening to details.

name: reportInputDuringAgentSpeech
description: Whether you receive caller input that arrives while the agent is talking. This is separate from whether it interrupts.
consider: Combine with interruptible='none' to hear the caller during a disclosure without stopping it. Default was 'any' before May 2025.

name: dtmfDetection
description: Send keypresses to your app as {type:'dtmf'} messages.
consider: A good fallback for yes/no in loud places ('press 1 to accept').

name: echoPromptFiltering
description: Helps drop transcripts that are just the agent's own voice echoing back, such as from a speakerphone.
consider: Try it if callers on speakerphone cause the agent to 'interrupt itself'. Check the docs for current behavior.

name: preemptible
description: Default for whether a new text reply can cut off one that's still playing. This can also be set per text message.
consider: Useful if your app sends a filler line ('let me check…') and then the real answer.

name: events
description: Space-separated extra events: speaker-events, tokens-played, config-updated.
consider: tokens-played tells you what was actually spoken. Use it to time 'end' precisely instead of this app's estimate timer.

name: debug
description: Extra debugging messages over the WebSocket.
consider: Turn on while developing and watch the Inspector for new message types.

name: intelligenceService
description: Conversation Intelligence Service SID (GA...) or unique name. The transcript is sent there for post-call analytics.
consider: Great for QA. Run operators such as 'did the agent confirm identity before sharing details?' across every call.

name: conversationConfiguration
description: Conversation Orchestrator configuration ID. Links this voice session into an omnichannel conversation.
consider: Use when the same nurse might continue over SMS or chat.

name: conversationId
description: Attach to an existing Orchestrator conversation (skips grouping rules).
consider: Use when you already know which conversation this call belongs to.
